scripts.dev: node scripts/configure-dev-app-name.mjs && lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; bun run compile && bunx concurrently --kill-others -n vite,electron 'VITE_PORT=5173 bunx --bun vite --port 5173' 'sleep 2 && VITE_PORT=5173 node scripts/run-dev-app.mjs'
scripts.build: bun run build:helper && bun run build:bootstrap && bunx --bun vite build && bun run compile
scripts.compile: bun run --cwd ../voice-service build && bunx tsc && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && mv dist/main/preload.js dist/main/preload.cjs && mv dist/main/lite-preload.js dist/main/lite-preload.cjs
scripts.build:lite: bun run build:bootstrap && bunx --bun vite build --config vite.lite.config.ts && bun run compile
scripts.package:lite:mac: node scripts/verify-staged-runtime.mjs --target darwin-arm64 && bun run build:lite && node ../../scripts/stage-agent-packages-for-packaging.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder-lite.yml --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.package:lite:win: node scripts/verify-staged-runtime.mjs --target windows-amd64 && bun run build:lite && node ../../scripts/stage-agent-packages-for-packaging.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder-lite.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.electron: node scripts/configure-dev-app-name.mjs && bun run compile && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/run-dev-app.mjs
scripts.start: node scripts/configure-dev-app-name.mjs && bunx --bun vite build && bun run compile && NODE_ENV=production node scripts/run-dev-app.mjs
scripts.package:mac: node scripts/verify-staged-runtime.mjs --target darwin-arm64 && bun run build && node ../../scripts/stage-agent-packages-for-packaging.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.package:win: node scripts/verify-staged-runtime.mjs --target windows-amd64 && bun run build && node ../../scripts/stage-agent-packages-for-packaging.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64
